analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 55.5 continues to consolidate in neutral territory, while MACD histogram shows improvement (-0.0663) but remains negative. The 5-day low is higher than the 20-day low, signaling a potential Higher Low pattern entry. Volume is subdued at 0.90 of the 5-day average. Weekly RSI at 70.2 is entering overbought territory, indicating a potential momentum conflict between daily and weekly charts. ADX at 19.2 suggests a lack of established trend. Maintaining a wait-and-see approach.
